title: [학사] 영어졸업인증 대체특강 안내 (2027-2월 졸업대상자)

analysis.target: 2027년 2월 졸업심사대상자(학사학위 수료자 포함). 단, 신청종료일까지 자격기준에 미달되는 공인영어성적표(토익(스피킹), New TEPS, OPIC 등) 제출기록 필수(제출할 곳: 학과사무실); 제출기록이 없는 학생 신청불가
summary: 2027년 2월 졸업심사대상자(학사학위 수료자 포함)를 위한 영어졸업인증 대체특강 안내입니다.
신청자격: 신청종료일까지 학과사무실에 자격기준에 미달되는 공인영어성적표(토익(스피킹), New TEPS, OPIC 등) 제출기록이 있는 학생만 신청 가능하며 제출기록이 없는 학생은 신청할 수 없습니다.
신청방법: 인하포털시스템 로그인 → 학적 → 학적인터넷신청 → [신청종류] 졸업인증토익특강 → 수강희망반(오전반/오후반) 선택 후 [저장]
강의기간 및 수강료: 2026.12.28.(월) ~ 2027.01.08.(금) 17:00 (녹화형 동영상 수업 및 실시간 퀴즈), 수강료 무료
analysis.easyExplanation: 2027년 2월 졸업심사대상자 및 학사학위 수료자 중 기준 미달 공인영어성적표를 미리 제출한 학생을 대상으로 무료 영어졸업인증 대체특강이 열립니다. 2026년 12월 21일 09시부터 12월 22일 16시까지 인하포털시스템에서 신청할 수 있습니다. 수강 후 출석, 과제, 시험 성적 등 평가결과에 따라 영어졸업인증 취득 여부가 판정됩니다.

en.title: [Academic] Notice on Alternative Special Lecture for English Graduation Certification (For Feb 2027 Graduation Candidates)
summary: Notice regarding the alternative special lecture for English graduation certification for candidates scheduled for graduation evaluation in February 2027 (including bachelor's degree completion students (수료자)).

Eligibility: Only students who have a record of submitting an official English score report (TOEIC (Speaking), New TEPS, OPIC, etc.) that falls short of the qualification standard to their department office by the application deadline are eligible; students without a submission record cannot apply.

Application method: Log in to Inha Portal System → Academic Affairs (학적) → Academic Internet Application (학적인터넷신청) → [Application Type] Graduation Certification TOEIC Special Lecture (졸업인증토익특강) → Select preferred class (Morning/Afternoon) → Save.
Lecture period & Tuition: December 28, 2026 (Mon) – January 8, 2027 (Fri) 17:00 (Recorded online video lectures and live quizzes), Tuition free.
en.easyExplanation: A free alternative special lecture for English graduation certification is available for February 2027 graduation candidates and completion students (수료자) who have already submitted below-standard official English score reports. Eligible students can apply through the Inha Portal System from December 21, 2026, 09:00 to December 22, 2026, 16:00. English graduation certification will be granted based on evaluation results such as attendance, assignments, and test scores.
en.target: Candidates for graduation assessment in February 2027 (including bachelor's degree completion students (학사학위 수료자)). Note: Must have a record of submitting an official English score report (TOEIC (Speaking), New TEPS, OPIC, etc.) below the standard to the department office by the application deadline; students without a submission record cannot apply.
en.eventInfo: Online alternative special lecture for English graduation certification (recorded lectures and real-time quizzes)
